source.description:
Discovered-from coordinator architecture input (post-qcy.3). LLMs own collaboration CONTENT; the runtime owns collaboration MECHANICS. Agents must never have to remember to create monitors after requesting a reply, poll for it, change their own state to stay wakeable, inspect whether a reply arrived, or track mandatory inbound requests.

Contract: one ChannelCommunicationService exposing send / request / reply / inbox as SEMANTIC operations over the canonical Channels contract (docs/channels/channels.md — normative). Channels semantic authority preserved: participant_id stable logical recipient; activation/job/session identity separate; message body != authority; read != ack; delivered != processed != replied. NO provider-specific transport (no Claude SendMessage, no codex queue) inside this layer — those are xtmux-owned bounded spikes/adapters (xtmux#110, #114).

Ownership split (post-#89 canon): Channels + chain runtime own semantic messages and reply obligations; xtmux owns provider delivery, observation, receipts, wake/injection, fallback, reconciliation.

For direct XTRM-hosted Pi AgentSessions: inject semantic tools through ActivationSupervisor. xtmux/tmux is not the correctness boundary. For interactive/external runtimes: route delivery intents via xtmux RuntimeSupervisor/provider adapters.

Placement guidance: pure semantic contracts first (schema + validation + correlation identity), no daemon.
